problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/ed064e23e4d1d11d4e40ef33478eb23860874463d6ce53e6fa3817010a7bd80d.png)

The scatter plot above shows the relationship between heating time and water temperature during an experiment. What is the temperature of the water $4$ minutes after heating has started?
worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/ecedab7bd2fbf79a2fec2e6deabccd292eed5c585efd1268ff675214a0eb2411.png)

To determine the temperature of the water $4$ minutes after heating has started, we locate $4$ on the horizontal axis and move in the vertical direction until we find some points, as shown above. 

The highlighted point has coordinates $(4,95).$ Therefore, the temperature of the water $4$ minutes after heating has started is $95{\,}^{∘}C.$

Question 6
?

The scatter plot above shows the relationship between heating time and water temperature during an experiment. What is the temperature of the water 4 minutes after heating has started?

a
87∘C
b
80∘C
c
85∘C
d
95∘C
e
97∘C
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To determine the temperature of the water 4 minutes after heating has started, we locate 4 on the horizontal axis and move in the vertical direction until we find some points, as shown above.

The highlighted point has coordinates (4,95). Therefore, the temperature of the water 4 minutes after heating has started is 95∘C.
